[vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
[vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_africon_travel_support{margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;}"]
<div class="africon-page africon-travel-support">
<div class="page-hero">
      <div class="container">
        <h1>Travel Support</h1>
        
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="page-layout">
      <aside class="sidebar">
        <h3>Travel Support</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#status">Current Status</a></li>
          <li><a href="#vcf">Region 8 VCF</a></li>
          <li><a href="#other">Other Programmes</a></li>
          <li><a href="#process">Future Process</a></li>
        </ul>
      </aside>

      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 id="status">Current Status</h2>
        <p>
          No IEEE AFRICON 2027 travel-support programme is currently open and
          no funding is guaranteed. The organizing committee is investigating
          possible programmes, but eligibility, application dates, award values
          and available budgets depend on the applicable 2027 rules and formal
          approvals. Do not make travel commitments on the assumption that an
          award will be available.
        </p>

        <h2 id="vcf">IEEE Region 8 Voluntary Contribution Fund</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE Region 8's Voluntary Contribution Fund has historically
          supported eligible low-income IEEE members with travel and subsistence
          for accepted contributions at qualifying Region 8 events. AFRICON
          2027 participation, eligibility and application instructions remain
          subject to the 2027 VCF rules. Review the
          <a href="https://ieeer8.org/category/voluntary-contribution-fund/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">official IEEE Region 8 VCF page</a>
          for authoritative information. This page is not an offer of funding.
        </p>

        <h2 id="other">Other Programmes Under Investigation</h2>
        <ul>
          <li>IEEE Women in Engineering travel grants</li>
          <li>IEEE Region 8 Professional and Educational Activities speaker support</li>
          <li>IEEE Region 8 Standards-related programme support</li>
          <li>IEEE Society, Council and Chapter support</li>
        </ul>
        <p>
          These programmes are listed only as areas being investigated. They
          are not AFRICON 2027 funding opportunities unless a later official
          call appears on this website with confirmed rules and contacts.
        </p>

        <h2 id="process">Future Application Process</h2>
        <p>
          If support is confirmed, this page will publish the funding source,
          eligibility criteria, required documents, selection method, conflicts
          process, deadlines, notification date, payment or reimbursement
          method, and a named contact. Awards will be made only through the
          official process; applicants should never pay a fee to apply for
          travel support.
        </p>
        <p>
          Questions may be sent through the
          <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/contact-us/#message">conference contact form</a> by selecting
          <strong>Registration</strong>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
</div>
[/vc_column_text]
[/vc_column][/vc_row]
